exposure = (REV_last - COGS_last) / ASSETS_last; primary revenue/COGS field per entity = the priority-ordered field with the most period groups (ties broken by the declared priority order); latest evidenced vintage with avail strictly before the decision session and within 800d; abstain fail-closed on missing/non-positive/stale

exposure = (REV_last/ASSETS_last) - (REV_prev/ASSETS_prev) across consecutive eff periods of the SAME field stream (never across revisions of one period); all four stamps strictly before the decision session and within 800d; abstain fail-closed
